text:
Maya S.: quick heads-up — we're rolling a coordinated docs + SDK compatibility change tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Breaking rename: `request_stream` -> `response_mode` across generated clients and examples.

Tim R.: hosted API behavior? immediate or grace period?

Maya S.: grace period. Hosted will accept `request_stream` for 30 days and respond with deprecation header `X-Redwood-Deprecation: response_mode` plus a warning in the response body. After 30 days requests using the old key will get 400.

Olga P.: can SDKs add a shim to accept both keys and emit warnings during migration?

Samir K.: already put drafts. js-sdk: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/234 (draft) — accepts both keys, logs a console.warn. py-sdk: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/178 (draft) — warns via logging.warn. Both include tests.

Maya S.: rollout plan:
- today: publish migration guide + codemod examples, update examples in api-ref and quickstarts
- 02:00 UTC tomorrow: publish docs site, enable support banner on dashboard, kick search reindex
- +30 days: hard reject old param on hosted API

Reindex command:
```
make docs-build && ./scripts/reindex-search --push --env=prod
```

Quick codemod snippet for JS examples:
```
# macOS/BSD sed example
find docs -name "*.md" -exec sed -i '' 's/request_stream/response_mode/g' {} +
```

Tim R.: should we notify customers directly? email + support banner?

Maya S.: yes. Draft email on Confluence: https://confluence.redwoodinc/KB/SDK-migration-draft — please review. Support playbook attached on the page; CS + Sales will be pinged after publish.

Olga P.: in release notes call out which code samples change, and include a migration TL;DR for infra/platform teams about pinning client versions during rollout.

Samir K.: I'll add an automated codemod job in js-sdk CI that can run when customers bump majors, and integration tests to both SDK PRs. Target merge ~1840005000.

docs-bot: Published docs build #482 to prod; search reindex queued for 2026-03-29 02:00 UTC. Redirect rules for legacy examples created.

Maya S.: thanks — after docs are live I'll post a short announcement in #general and ping Sales + CS for account outreach. :rocket: 

Tim R.: thanks Maya + Samir.

Olga P.: lgtm from docs side; I'll monitor support channel during rollout.

Samir K.: will follow up with PR links and a changelog blurb for the release email.
